_comment: R2c C4. The same instrument at another official publisher. `publishers` are the official publishers with the terms page that was READ and the date it was read; `bySchema` maps an identifier scheme to an ordered list of (publisher, URL template, channel kind). An entry whose status is `unverified` is never used: the gate fails closed on it, and `reason` says what was not verified. Credentials are read from the named env variables and the channel self-skips when they are unset (no lane registers an account). Templates take {id} and the named parts of the scheme; {today} is the run date.
